name: Thomas
overview: Thomas, also called Didymus, is recognized as one of the twelve apostles chosen by Jesus, as noted in the Gospels of Matthew, Mark, and Luke. He demonstrated both deep loyalty and human doubt; he courageously expressed his willingness to die with Jesus before Lazarus was raised, yet he was absent when Jesus first appeared to the disciples after the resurrection, leading to his initial skepticism. Thomas's honest questioning about the way to the Father's house reveals his desire for spiritual understanding, and his eventual encounter with the risen Christ affirms the reality of Jesus' resurrection and his place among the faithful apostles dwelling in Jerusalem.
